To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evening welcome playbook for Praxio exec workshop

Team —

Praxio's exec workshop is next Wednesday evening (9/15). They requested a hosted welcome reception + seated dinner after the day sessions. I want us to be prescriptive so there are no surprises. Draft asks below; please review and flag missing items.

High-level objectives:
- Keep the evening intimate (30–40 total) with a short welcome, 25-minute informal networking, then 75-minute seated dinner with two short Redwood demos on the big screen.
- Make transport simple for their senior execs (2 vehicles from hotel to venue, two run times: 6:00pm and 6:30pm).
- Ensure clear dietary accommodations and name cards to avoid last-minute changes.

Initial checklist (need owners):
- Venue confirmation & floorplan + AV specs (Jonas)
- Catering menu + dietary matrix (Marissa)
- Guest list + seating assignments (Monica)
- Transportation run-of-show (Sean)
- External invites & RSVP window (I will draft)

Attachments: I started a dietary matrix and a guest CSV (placeholders). Please use those files and update by EOD Thursday so I can send invites on Friday.

Thanks,
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference

Thanks — adding vendor details. I spoke with Copper Kitchen (local caterer we've used twice). They can do a plated three-course dinner with a separate vegan/gluten-free plated option. Key notes:
- Can accommodate 8 strict allergies (must confirm names).
- Will label courses on cards (allergy icons).
- Can provide boxed leftovers for the hosts if needed.
- AV: they require caterer staging away from AV cables; will need a marked service path on the floorplan.

I'll attach their sample menu and the vendor floorplan they sent. I'm tentatively proposing: starter: seasonal salad or chilled crab cake; main: herb-roasted chicken OR seared miso-cod OR charred cauliflower steak (vegan).

I'll own the dietary matrix updates. Can someone confirm the guest list today?

Marissa
Sr. Events Manager | Redwood Inference

- Confirmed: Sylvia Kim (CEO), Timothy Bradley (CFO), plus three VPs and a handful of directors — total 34 attendees.
- Dietary: 6 vegan, 4 pescatarian, 2 gluten-free + dairy, 3 nut allergies.
- Table preference: Sylvia prefers a head table with Mateo, Marissa, and two Praxio execs.

I've sketched a seating assignment draft and attached it (guest_table_assignments_v2.csv). If no objections, I'll finalize tonight and push to the Drive link. Also proposing printed place cards and a small welcome packet (agenda + 2‑page product brief).

Venue & AV update: I confirmed the private dining room at The Ember House. Key AV specs: projector with HDMI + laptop clicker, small lapel mic for Mateo, and one wireless handheld for Q&A. Capacities: theatre 50, banquet 40 — fits our 34.

Logistics asks for catering (to confirm with Marissa):
- Service path as Marissa noted — catering can use the side entrance at 5:30pm.
- Staging table for plated service near the kitchen; we need a 6' table for place cards and welcome packet at the entry.
- AV tech will be onsite at 5:30pm for cable routing.

I'll upload a final floorplan to the Drive link by tomorrow.

Subject: Welcome reception and dinner — practical details + RSVP request

Sylvia / Tim —

Thanks again for hosting the onsite. Quick practical notes for Wednesday 9/15 evening:
- Arrival: We recommend your group meet in the hotel lobby at 5:40pm; Redwoods' vehicle(s) will shuttle at 6:00pm and 6:30pm (two trips). If you prefer private car service, let us know.
- Venue: The Ember House, private dining room. Address + parking link: https://theemberhouse.example/parking
- Dinner: Plated three-course dinner; we noted dietary restrictions below and will label cards.
- AV: Short 7–10 minute demos after the welcome and one 5-minute closing demo.

Could you please: 1) confirm final headcount by Mon 9/14 EOD; 2) send any final dietary restrictions (names + allergies) to Monica.

Attendees (as currently listed): Sylvia Kim (CEO), Timothy Bradley (CFO), Dr. Anjali Rao (VP Product), Marcus Li (Head of Partnerships), plus directors and staff — total 34.

We have attached a short welcome packet and the dietary matrix for updates.

Best,
